integrity: The exact equality is proved by a continuum boundary-distance minimization. The recent source supplies the matching upper bound from the lobe's vertical width, while the new lower bound follows from strict monotonicity of an explicit boundary quotient. The asymptotic correction is obtained from the exact closed form; no numerical optimization or finite enumeration is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the exact inradius of the canonical roots-of-unity model z^n-1. It does not prove that this model minimizes the inradius among all admissible degree-n polynomials at any fixed n>1, and it makes no uniqueness claim for largest disk centers.
title: Exact finite-degree inradius of the roots-of-unity lemniscate
